name: Sasha Morozov
source:
"No, you will not change my mind, and no, I won't be tricked and deluded into a false sense of security by hollow promises and last-resort ideas, so that should be enough to let you know you're wasting your time."

Sasha introduces himself as cold and reserved, expressing a general unwillingness to interact with those around him. Due to the circumstances, he is reluctant to trust the others, and can't see what benefit that is supposed to have anyway.

Headstrong and opinionated, he looks down on anyone whose beliefs contrast with his own, and despises hypocrisy above all else. His huffy tone, snide remarks, and overall impatience towards most others do little to earn people's favor, but his loyalty to those he cares for is unconditional.

While he can be rather feisty and notably disdainful, he is a gentle soul deep down. one who prefers soothing activities such as writing over dealing with others.

[From [url=https://crimsonsugarstudio.wixsite.com/crimson-sugar-studio/meet-the-cast]Crimson Sugar Studio website[/url]]
